name: What should I consider when comparing new construction versus resale homes?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when comparing new construction versus resale homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: When comparing new construction versus resale homes, consider several factors. New construction often features modern layouts, energy-efficient appliances, and brand-new systems, reducing immediate maintenance concerns. Resale homes might offer more established neighborhoods, mature landscaping, and potentially lower price per square foot or negotiable pricing. A practical tradeoff is that new construction typically has longer closing periods due to build times, while resale homes offer quicker occupancy. Your choice depends on your priorities regarding move-in readiness, customization, and long-term maintenance needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: New construction offers modern features and lower initial maintenance but longer waits; resale offers established areas and quicker move-ins.
